text:
Liam (Product): Heads-up CobaltBank went dark on a compliance checklist: must have FIPS 140-2 HSM-backed BYOK with customer key import, immutable audit retention for 7 years in the EU region, SOC2 Type II evidence exports for external auditors, and an admin legal-hold toggle. They want a pilot sign-off in ~4 weeks. Can we scope a minimal, defensible deliverable and list hard blockers?

Noah (Eng): Quick scan of blockers: HSM import path (PKCS#11 vs cloud provider import), enforcing WORM storage semantics across regions, searchable redacted indices, and secure auditor access without exposing raw PII. Also need key lifecycle APIs (rotate, revoke) for BYOK.

Rhea (Security): Confirm FIPS requirement. We need vendor attestation for HSM usage, and a control map that ties our features to SOC2 controls. Also flag: GDPR Right to Erasure conflicts with 7-year retention + legal hold. Need legal to confirm prioritization.

Tess (AE): Cobalt will sign if we can promise a staged acceptance: Stage A (pilot): BYOK import + immutable EU storage + legal-hold UI. Stage B: SOC2 evidence automation + auditor access. They can accept Stage A within 4-6 weeks. Money on table. :tada:

Ivan (Legal): For GDPR conflict: we can support legal holds that override deletion for specified tenants if contractually agreed; need explicit clause. Also must define data export/evidence transfer legalese and cross-border transfer assurances for EU-only residency. I'll draft.

Noah (Eng): Proposed technical plan (minimal path):
- Accept HSM-wrapped key import (customer provides key wrapped using our public import key) - supports CloudHSM/Thales/PKCS#11 imports. (~2 sprints)
- Store audit streams to append-only buckets with Object Lock (governance mode) + signed manifest files per day. Use SHA-256 manifests and publish Merkle-root for tamper-evidence. (~1-2 sprints)
- Redacted search index: copy events to a redaction pipeline; raw logs remain in immutable store and are downloadable only via controlled export job which generates signed ZIP + manifest. (~2 sprints)

Rhea (Security): Short-term mitigation for pilot: VPC-restricted ingestion + Object Lock preview bucket + customer-managed KMS in a dedicated tenant. That reduces risk while we finish full import flow. Also require SOPs for key import and HSM attestation.

Clara (Ops): Ops concerns: 7 years on hot object store is expensive. Recommend policy: keep 90 days hot (searchable), snapshot + notarize (Merkle root) to cold archival (deep storage) with the ability to rehydrate on audit request within SLA (target 24-48hrs). Need cost model per TB-year.

Tess (AE): Cobalt's acceptance criteria: 1) BYOK import works and keys can't be exported by Redwood; 2) Audit logs stored immutably in EU region; 3) Legal-hold toggle prevents deletion; 4) Evidence retrieval within 24h with integrity proof. If we meet those, they'll sign pilot SOW.

Ivan (Legal): I'll add acceptance criteria for evidence integrity (manifest/sha256 + signed Merkle root), and require auditor access procedures (either secure SFTP drop with signed manifest or read-only VPN into a staging environment).

Noah (Eng): Risks we should call out: key escrow support increase (customers may ask us to escrow wrapped keys), complexity of supporting multiple HSM vendors, performance hit on continuous append-only writes, and additional egress controls for auditor exports.

Liam (Product): Prioritization suggestion: Must-have for pilot = Wrapped HSM import flow (basic PKCS#11/cloud import), Object Lock immutable store in EU, legal-hold API. Nice-to-have = automated SOC2 evidence package and auditor VPN.

Clara (Ops): Actionables from ops side: create archival lifecycle plan + cost estimate; define rehydration runbook and SLA. I can own that.

Rhea (Security): Actionables: list required attestations/certs (FIPS, HSM vendor certs), draft key-import SOP + attestation checklist. Will include interim mitigations.

Noah (Eng): Actionables: infra design doc for HSM import & immutable pipeline (due Tue), prototype manifest signing + Merkle root demo (due Fri).

Ivan (Legal): Actionables: contract clause draft for legal hold vs erasure + evidence acceptance tests (due Wed).

Tess (AE): I'll confirm CobaltBank's precise timeline and whether they insist on on-prem HSM (if on-prem, schedule +3-4 weeks). Also get billing commitment for archival costs.

deploy-bot: preview resources spun up: s3://cobalt-pilot-worm-eu (Object Lock enabled, expires in 14d), kms-import-keypair created for pilot imports.

Liam (Product): OK team. Let's treat the pilot as gated: no external auditor access until Stage B. Keep thread updated with blockers. I'll assemble a one-pager for Cobalt legal/ops after we have the drafts. :white_check_mark:
